title: Choose Alex's visual world
question: The roll assigned Intaglio Note. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Intaglio Note
options.lineage: US banknote engraving and security printing
options.thesis: Every answer is issued like a note: engraved, serial-numbered, and backed by visible evidence.
materials: currency paper with red and blue fibers
options.viewport: Green engraved header band; profile at left, conversation center, an evidence rail at right where each answer's guilloché provenance mark encodes its rules and tool calls.
options.risk: Read loosely it could feel like money-as-decoration; it must stay a working screen, not a costume.

raised.raise: One ink is reserved for the active answer's evidence trail; nothing else on the page uses it.
Focusing a citation or tool call reveals its source while the rest of the answer recedes.
A strict column grid governs all three work areas; nothing floats off it.
Every number (prices, %, timestamps) is set in tabular figures at data density.

options.label: Form 1040
options.thesis: The profile is a form with numbered lines; every answer is a schedule that cites them.
options.viewport: Profile as a boxed form with PS line numbers, answer as an attached schedule citing lines and rules.
options.risk: The most familiar reading of 'money paperwork', and forms carry tax-season dread.

options.label: Orienteering Map
options.thesis: Your plan as a course of controls ridden over the terrain of your finances.
options.viewport: Profile as terrain, the priority order as numbered controls.
options.case: Fuses poorly: judges do not identify with orienteering, and terrain obscures the answer text.
options.kept: A reserved overprint ink for the active course.

options.label: Streaming Title Wall
options.thesis: Personas and answers as rows of tiles that expand on focus.
options.viewport: Persona rows; the focused tile expands into the conversation.
options.case: Fuses poorly: long, cited answers don't fit tiles, and entertainment framing undercuts caution.
options.kept: Focus reveals detail while the rest recedes.

options.label: Acetate Tab Manual
options.thesis: The knowledge base as a tabbed manual; answers as acetate leaves over it.
options.viewport: Tab rail per KB section, answers layered above.
options.case: Fuses partly: the KB maps to tabs, but the demo is about one person's answer, not browsing a manual.
options.kept: Tabs sized by extent show the whole book at a glance.
options.risk: Heavy material system for a single chat surface.

options.label: Crouwel Grid Specimen
options.thesis: A visible construction grid with monumental grid-built numerals.
options.viewport: Grid-built headline numbers over a neutral answer column.
options.case: Fuses poorly: striking but says nothing about money, rules, or trust.
options.kept: The grid as a real, visible armature.

options.label: Design Annual Plates
options.thesis: Answers as printed plates with registration marks and a signed stamp.
options.viewport: One continuous sheet with hairline-divided credits.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a gallery register for a working tool; the stamp implies endorsement.
options.kept: Hairline rules carry all division; no boxes.

options.label: Datamatics Field
options.thesis: Market data as a strobing black-and-white barcode field.
options.viewport: Price history rendered as data texture behind the answer.
options.case: Fuses poorly: strobing and pure black/white fight long-form reading and projector comfort.
options.kept: Numbers at true data density in tabular columns.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean fintech assistant: white, navy, one blue accent, at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Profile sidebar, chat center, collapsible tool calls.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every robo-advisor by design.
